correctness.rationale: The smooth genus-two quintic and the Frobenius-stable two-node pushout are explicit. The functions \(f_{\pm c}\) are constant on both gluing pairs and each has poles of total order 3, yielding honest degree-three maps over F9. Any normalization-degree-two pencil is fractional linear in x and mismatches both nodes, forcing degree 4 on the singular curve. Degree-three pencils lie in two distinct translates of the principal theta curve on Pic^3(Y), whose intersection number is 2. The two explicit pencils are inequivalent and therefore exhaust a reduced intersection. Frobenius c↦−c interchanges them, excluding F3 descent. The x-pencil has torsion-free degree 4, so gonality over F3 is exactly 4. Exact input computations were replayed from verify.py; the theta argument is a proof, not an experimental extrapolation.
